text: Bethany has a second interview at the council on May 14. She sounded calm about it, which is a first. Text her good luck the night before.
Rana lives in Leeds now, just off Kirkstall Road. Works at the university library, mostly in archives.
Ioana's brother Rory got the apprenticeship he applied for. Starts on June 3rd. Their mum is thrilled, apparently she cried on the phone to Ioana for twenty minutes.
Alejandro applied for the senior designer role at the agency in Bristol. Hasn't heard back yet. Should ask him next week whether they've replied.
Archie and his wife Petra are off to Lisbon for their tenth anniversary, 2 November 2026 to the 9th. He wants restaurant tips, so send him that list from Mei.
Thomas is a nurse at St James's, nights mostly. His partner Duc teaches maths at a secondary in Headingley. They have two boys, both under five.
Rosa's interview on 5/14 was cancelled because the hiring manager left. She's annoyed but says she'll keep applying.

Mei mentioned her dad is having a knee replacement in March 2027, finally, after two years on the waiting list. She's worried about who will look after her mum while he recovers, because her mum has early dementia and gets confused when the routine changes. Her brother lives in Glasgow and can only come down for a weekend. I should check in with her in the new year and see whether she needs a hand with lifts.
Javier, or Javi as everyone calls him, is moving to Valencia in the spring. His sister already lives there and has a spare room for him.
Picked up the dry cleaning and booked the car in for its MOT on November 12th.
Imogen is nervous about the panel interview on Thursday. Four people on the panel, plus a presentation on her first ninety days. Must send her a message Wednesday evening.
Ebony's cat Biscuit went missing on Saturday and turned up Monday morning in a neighbour's shed. Ebony hasn't slept properly all week.

Yusuf grew up in Bradford but has lived in Manchester for fifteen years, first in Rusholme and now in Chorlton. He works for an engineering firm in Salford Quays doing bridge inspections. Supports City, plays five-a-side on Tuesdays, and is learning Turkish for his wife's family, who are mostly in Izmir. His older brother is a GP back in Bradford.
Mia's son Reza starts at the grammar school in September. She's proud but quietly terrified about the commute.

Had coffee with Petra. She's been at the bank for eight years and is finally thinking about leaving. She applied for two roles last month, one at a charity and one in local government. The charity one replied and she has a first-round video call on October 28th. She doesn't want her manager to find out yet. Her husband Archie thinks she should go for it. Remember to ask her how the call went.
Duc's grandmother passed away last week. The funeral is in Hanoi, and he flies out on the 25th with his mother.
Ben said Aaliyah's birthday is June 9th and she has been hinting about a new pair of running shoes for weeks.
Keisha got the job! Operations lead at the hospital trust, starting 1 December 2026. Send her a card.
Karim and Khadija have finally bought the house in Didsbury. They complete on November 20th and move the weekend after.
Kiara works from home three days a week. Her office is in Canary Wharf but she lives out in Woking with her girlfriend and an elderly greyhound called Pepper.
Beatriz asked if I could give her a reference for the teaching assistant job. Deadline is October 31st. Need to write it this weekend.

Ricardo is still struggling after the redundancy. He has sent out about forty applications since July and had one interview, which went nowhere. His wife Dalia is doing extra shifts at the care home to cover the mortgage, and their eldest has started asking questions. He did mention a warehouse supervisor role that closes on November 8th, so he's going to apply for that. I'll ring him on Sunday and offer to go through the application with him.
Dalia's mum is turning seventy on January 14th. They're planning a surprise lunch at the Italian place near the station.
Kalani passed her driving test this morning, first time. Her dad had bet her twenty quid she wouldn't.
Shreya is finishing her PhD in Edinburgh. Viva is pencilled in for March 2027. Her supervisor is Dr Banerjee, who apparently is lovely but very slow with feedback.
Omar's brother Karim is the one who works at the airport, not Omar. Omar is an electrician and lives in Salford with his parents.
Fang had her interview at the museum today. She thinks it went well, though they asked a lot about budgets. They said they'd let her know by Friday. Ask her on Saturday if she heard anything.

Long call with Rosa tonight. Her brother Javier is getting married on August 8th in Seville, and the whole family is flying out. Her grandmother can't travel, so they're arranging a video link. Rosa is a bridesmaid and is panicking about the speech she has to give. She also mentioned she's been offered a promotion at work but hasn't decided whether to take it, because it would mean managing her old team. She wants to talk it through properly over dinner.
Ioana is allergic to nuts, all of them, including coconut. Keep that in mind for the Christmas dinner.
Thomas and Duc are hosting a housewarming on Saturday the 7th. I'm bringing dessert.
Bethany's interview went well and they offered her the job on the spot! She starts on June 3rd. Her partner Rory is taking her out to celebrate.
Archie mentioned his dog Murphy needs an operation on his hip. It's booked for next Tuesday and Archie is dreading the bill.
Rana's daughter Mia is sitting her GCSEs from May 11 through June 20. Rana says she's doing well but is stressed about chemistry.
Mrs Lopez from next door said her husband is back in hospital. Don't forget to drop round some soup tomorrow.
Petra's sister Imogen lives in Cardiff. Works as a solicitor, specialises in family law. Two kids, Archie and Rosa, confusingly.

Alejandro heard back from Bristol. They want him in for an in-person interview on 11/3, with a design task to prepare: a rebrand pitch for a fictional bakery chain, ten slides maximum. He's thrilled but nervous about the task, especially presenting it to the creative director, who he admires. His girlfriend Kiara is going to sit through a practice run with him on the weekend. Send him the portfolio examples I promised.
Call the bank about the direct debit. Also cancel the gym membership before the 1st.
Yusuf's wife Kiara is expecting their first in April. They haven't told work yet.
Reza is applying for jobs in Dubai. He has two video interviews next week, one on Monday and one on Wednesday, both at awkward times because of the time difference. Wish him luck on Sunday.
Ebony works at a vet's in Harrogate. Lives with her mum. Doesn't eat meat, hasn't for years.
Mei's partner Ben ran the Leeds half marathon yesterday in under two hours. Mei says he's already looking at the London ballot for April 2027.
Keisha's leaving drinks are on November 27th at the Crown. Buy something for the collection before Friday.
Karim was offered the store manager job but turned it down. The commute would have been an hour and a half each way. He seems relieved.
Kalani's grandfather, Uncle Ricardo to everyone, is retiring after forty years at the docks. Party is on 15 March 2027.
Bought stamps, posted the forms, and booked my eye test for October 29th.

Shreya's parents are visiting from Pune from December 2nd until January 10th. It's their first trip to the UK and her dad has a whole list of football grounds he wants to see. She's excited but her flat is tiny, so they're staying with her cousin Dalia in Croydon. Dalia's husband Omar has offered to drive them around on weekends, which Shreya thinks is very brave of him.
Fang, also known as Fifi to her sisters, grew up in Singapore and moved to London for university. She now lives in Walthamstow and works in insurance.
Omar mentioned he has an interview with the fire service on 6/18. He's been training for the fitness test since January. I should text him the day after to see how it went.
Beatriz and Ricardo's wedding is off. They split up in September and she has moved back in with her parents in Leicester. She's coping, but only just.
Mia wants to go back to work now the twins are at nursery. She's looking at part-time roles in HR but feels out of practice. Offered to look over her CV, so I need to do that by next week.
Thomas Baker, the new neighbour at number 12, is a retired firefighter. Grows tomatoes in his greenhouse and has a parrot called Captain.
Javier's daughter Rosa had her first ballet recital on Sunday. He sent a video. Ask him how she felt about it afterwards.
Archie said Petra's dad is having tests on his heart next month. Petra is trying to stay positive but it's clearly getting to her.
Aaliyah and Keisha are flatmates in Hackney. Aaliyah works in publishing and Keisha is a paramedic.

Rory has applied to three graduate schemes, with deadlines on November 5th, November 18th and December 1st. One is at the civil service, one at a big accountancy firm and one at an engineering consultancy in Birmingham. His mum keeps pushing the accountancy one but he's keener on engineering. He asked if I'd read his cover letters. Need to get back to him before the 5th, ideally this weekend, and then again mid-November for the others.
Imogen's interview on Thursday went better than expected. They want her back for a second round on May 2nd. Her mum is driving down to look after the kids that day.
Lovely chat with Ioana at the school gate. Nothing much new, just the usual chaos with the kids.

Khadija's brother Yusuf is planning to propose at Christmas. She found the ring in his coat pocket and is sworn to secrecy. Meanwhile her mum turns sixty on February 4th and Khadija thinks she would love a framed family photo, so she's trying to get everyone together for one before then. Their dad is useless at this sort of thing and keeps suggesting a new hoover.

Dalia has an interview for the head of finance role on October 30th. Her boss doesn't know. She's quietly confident. Must remember to ask her on the 31st how it went, and if it's good news, take her out for a drink.
Duc Lee, 'Ducky' at work, is the most organised person in the office. He's from Hanoi originally and his whole family is still there.
